title: [review] tx_queue.py:405: `pop()` signals reservation su
description: The `pop()` method calls `entry.reservation.set_result(True)` immediately upon dequeue, before the packet is actually transmitted over radio. The `TxReservation.wait()` docstring promises 'Returns True if transmitted', but `pop()` signals True before transmission. If the caller subsequently fails to transmit the packet, callers awaiting the reservation will incorrectly believe transmission succeeded.
close_reason: Fixed: pop() no longer signals reservation.set_result(True) prematurely. The method now only dequeues the packet without signaling success. Callers must use reserve()/complete() pattern for proper transmission tracking with reservation support.
